# Learning Allied
> AI Study Partner & Adaptive Socratic Learning Platform for Indian Students (JEE, NEET, CBSE & Maharashtra State Board).

Website: https://www.learningallied.world
Founder: Prem Jain (https://www.learningallied.world/founder)
Platform Category: Educational Technology / AI Tutor / Socratic Learning Assistant

## Overview
Learning Allied (https://learningallied.world) is an evidence-based AI study platform built specifically for Indian students preparing for high-stakes competitive exams (JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG) and board examinations (CBSE Class 9–12, Maharashtra SSC & HSC). Unlike generic AI chatbots that immediately give away homework answers (encouraging passive consumption), Learning Allied employs Socratic tutoring, prerequisite diagnosis, active recall, and algorithmically spaced repetition to ensure students master core conceptual foundations and develop true problem-solving stamina.

## Key Capabilities & Pedagogy
- **Socratic Cognitive Scaffolding**: Refuses to output direct answers to conceptual physics, chemistry, or math questions. Instead, it diagnoses the student's premise, identifies misunderstandings, and prompts them to derive the next step independently.
- **Prerequisite Knowledge Graph**: When a student struggles with complex topics (e.g., Rotational Dynamics, Chemical Bonding, Electromagnetic Induction), Learning Allied maps backwards into foundational Class 9–11 concepts to find the unaddressed prerequisite gap.
- **Active Retrieval Quizzes**: Topic-wise diagnostic retrieval questions calibrated to exact NTA and Board patterns with zero hallucinated or off-syllabus trivia.
- **Spaced Review Engine**: Models individual student forgetting curves based on the Ebbinghaus retention model to schedule revisions right before neural decay sets in.
- **Strict Curricular Alignment**: Grounded in official NCERT syllabi (CBSE, JEE, NEET) and Balbharati textbooks (Maharashtra State Board SSC Class 10 & HSC Class 12 Science).
